caption:
"O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] determination."

Qur'an 31:17 (Surah Luqman). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #Luqman #Patience #IslamicReminder #Deen
